note: Study official docs and permitted public sources. Absorb jobs and contracts. Do not clone vendor source, UI, or branding. A paper benchmark is not an SZL benchmark.

entries.claim: An operational layer maps datasets and models to objects, properties, links, and authorized actions.
entries.limitation: Foundry is a closed commercial platform. Documentation is not a license to copy product UI or data models.
entries.adaptation: Keep evidence-bound objects and scientist-authorized actions inside existing immune and frontier organs. NEXUS stays an organ, not a new Space.
rejectedAlternatives: treat ontology membership as production admission
entries.validationExperiment: No Foundry code executed. Pattern recorded against flotation receipts that already require hashed inputs and BLOCK recovery-as-score.

entries.claim: Blueprint is a React UI toolkit. Frontend work is task to result to evidence, not visual styling alone.
entries.limitation: Repository instructions are untrusted inputs. No files were copied.
entries.adaptation: Preserve existing holographic tokens, 44px targets, and reduced-motion. Keep product journeys on a-11-oy.com and proof on a11oy.net.
rejectedAlternatives: rewrite working TypeScript into Python for styling
entries.validationExperiment: No Blueprint package installed. Existing frontier organ UI remains the surface.

entries.claim: Lattice exposes typed objects, entities, and tasking APIs for an authorized operator graph.
entries.limitation: Weapons, targeting, and physical tasking remain human-authorized only. SDK presence is not an Anduril integration.
entries.adaptation: Keep typed contracts and fail-closed authorization in services. No autonomous trading, targeting, or laboratory actuation.
rejectedAlternatives: install the SDK as a production dependency
entries.validationExperiment: SDK not installed. Pattern compared to existing ouroboros HARD_DENY and flotation BLOCK paths.

entries.claim: An agent toolkit can orchestrate tools around models.
entries.limitation: Installing the toolkit does not qualify SZL routing, receipts, or authorization.
entries.adaptation: Preserve szl-router as the inference flagship. Add tools only behind existing idempotency and cancellation contracts.
entries.validationExperiment: Toolkit not installed. Router remains GitHub szl-router to Hub SZLHOLDINGS/llm-router-live.

entries.license: Apache-2.0 for huggingface/kernels; Hub artifacts rechecked individually
entries.claim: Hub kernels are a first-class kernel repository type with trusted publishers, build/<variant> layout, ABI3/manylinux_2_28, and version branches.
entries.limitation: Legacy model-type kernel artifacts can share an id with a native kernel-type repo while carrying a different SHA. Loading untrusted publishers requires an explicit opt-in that SZL refuses by default.
entries.adaptation: Keep native and model-hosted identities distinct. Do not migrate or delete legacy artifacts until consumers and rollback paths are reconciled. Do not enable unrestricted trust_remote_code.
rejectedAlternatives: infer GPU qualification from CPU tests
entries.validationExperiment: Bootstrap listed 14 kernel-type repos under SZLHOLDINGS. Same-id native vs model SHAs differed for szl-kernels, szl-formulas, and szl-maskmod. GPU timing remains PENDING on this host.

entries.claim: Each LLM request can be a trace with spans for tools, tokens, latency, errors, and safety evaluations.
entries.limitation: Product is billed per LLM span. No new paid Datadog spend is authorized. Prompt bodies are sensitive.
entries.adaptation: Preserve trace IDs across retrieval, model calls, policies, actions, and receipts inside existing organs. Scrub sensitive content before export.
entries.validationExperiment: No Datadog agent installed. Compared to existing frontier receipts and a11oy signer ABSENT HOLD.

inspectedSections: Whats New OTEL AI monitoring card
entries.claim: OpenTelemetry AI spans can carry model and token signals into an existing APM backend.
entries.limitation: Announcement is not an SZL integration. No new paid New Relic spend is authorized.
entries.adaptation: Connect LYTE technical signals to defined business journeys only when those journeys already exist in source.
entries.validationExperiment: No New Relic agent installed. Pattern recorded; LYTE Hub pin remains a separate publication gate.

entries.claim: Versioned model lifecycle and traces can bind experiments to exact artifacts.
entries.limitation: MLflow traces are not SZL receipts. Installing MLflow does not replace signed provenance.
entries.adaptation: Keep existing typed contracts and generate clients from versioned schemas. Unsigned consistency stays distinct from authenticated provenance.
entries.validationExperiment: MLflow not installed. Existing receipt stack remains the evidence plane.

entries.claim: A k-layer transformer looped L times can approach a kL-layer non-looped model on some reasoning tasks; looping is not free compute.
entries.limitation: Abstract-plus-venue only. Paper benchmark is not an SZL benchmark. Agent retry loops are not recurrent-depth architecture.
entries.adaptation: If looped models are evaluated later, compare fixed-depth, adaptive-depth, and nonlooped baselines under the same budget. Cache and stop tests are required.
rejectedAlternatives: train a looped model because the paper exists
equate extra loops with free accuracy
entries.validationExperiment: No weights trained. Evaluation remains HOLD.

entries.authorMaintainer: Ying Fan, Anej Svete, Kangwook Lee
entries.claim: LOTUS reports latent CoT with looped padded Transformers and parallel supervision on gold CoT tokens at 3B scale.
entries.limitation: Preprint. Not peer-reviewed in this register. Code was not executed.
entries.adaptation: Record as prior art for latent vs explicit reasoning. Do not load untrusted training code.
rejectedAlternatives: treat preprint numbers as SZL results
entries.validationExperiment: Abstract-only. HOST and GPU qualification PENDING.

entries.authorMaintainer: Mingqian Yu, Wenpeng Zhang, Shaobo Cui, Peilin Zhao
entries.claim: Token-choice routing can assign per-token loop depth; recursion-wise KV cache keeps depths from mixing.
entries.limitation: Preprint. Paper latency claims are not measured on SZL hardware.
entries.adaptation: If evaluated, separate agent retries from recurrent depth and test cache reset boundaries.
rejectedAlternatives: infer GPU speed from the abstract
reuse parameters as if extra compute were free
entries.validationExperiment: Abstract-only. No GPU timing on this host.

entries.authorMaintainer: Mahdi Nasiri, Sahel Iqbal, Simo Särkkä
entries.claim: Physics-informed nets predicted concentrate gold grade on simulated two-cell froth-flotation data better than purely data-driven nets on MSE/MRE.
entries.limitation: Abstract-only. Simulated cells. Grade is not recovery and is not selectivity. Discourse topic 412 remains login-gated and was not scraped.
entries.adaptation: Keep the existing MODELED flotation rank on public_score/screen_score. BLOCK recovery/grade/selectivity as the score column. Do not invent minerals or reagents from the gated forum.
rejectedAlternatives: report synthetic success as a laboratory result
entries.validationExperiment: Existing python/tests/test_flotation.py already fail-closes recovery-as-score and missing bench. No PINN trained.

entries.claim: A 2026 Separation and Purification Technology article was cited as a flotation screening reference.
entries.limitation: DOI was not fetched through a licensed session in this pass. Content remains UNAVAILABLE.
entries.adaptation: Do not cite unseen figures. Keep public anchors in the flotation skill labeled as not our numbers.

entries.claim: MiniEmbed-Nano is a SHA-256 token-id modulo-64 hash/table fixture, not MiniEmbed 3290x128 and not a general scientific embedder.
entries.limitation: Unsuitable as a production retrieval model. Do not load untrusted pickle.
entries.adaptation: Keep as a SOFTWARE test fixture. Do not integrate into science retrieval.
entries.validationExperiment: Hub card and status.json inspected at the pinned SHA. No training run.

entries.limitation: The pack gap is pending, not an accidental outage. Community PR #8 is UNSTABLE on the blocked security scaffold. Claude host import was not executed.
